qsm-book-to-skill validate.description: Expand the given paths into the sources this converter can read, and name every one it cannot with the reason; writes sources.json

args.name: input
args.description: file, directory, or glob to convert; name more of them on the command line for several

args.name: work
args.description: run directory for every stage's files

qsm-book-to-skill extract.description: Turn every validated source into text, consolidate it, and report each source's size, pages, words, tokens and detected chapters; writes text.md and metadata.json

args.name: sources
args.description: the validate stage's sources.json (defaults to the one in the run directory)

args.name: work
args.description: run directory for every stage's files

qsm-book-to-skill analyze.description: Find the chapter boundaries in the consolidated text and estimate each chapter's size; writes structure.json

args.name: text
args.description: the consolidated text (defaults to the one in the run directory)

args.name: work
args.description: run directory for every stage's files

qsm-book-to-skill draft.description: Write one file per chapter holding that chapter's own text and one summary scaffold beside it

args.name: out
args.description: draft directory (defaults to draft/ in the run directory)

args.name: work
args.description: run directory for every stage's files

qsm-book-to-skill assemble.description: Build the skill directory from the filled drafts: the chapter summaries and one master skill definition

args.name: draft
args.description: the draft directory to assemble from

args.name: out
args.description: directory the skill is created in (defaults to QSM_SKILLS_DIR, else skills/ in the run directory)

args.name: name
args.description: the slug to use instead of the one derived from the text's first heading

args.name: description
args.description: the generated skill's description: when to load it, in the words a user would say

args.name: work
args.description: run directory for every stage's files

qsm-book-to-skill scan.description: Judge an assembled skill against the rules a skill has to meet (frontmatter, size, links, no draft placeholder, no page reference), exit non-zero on any finding, and print where it is and what it holds

args.name: work
args.description: run directory for every stage's files

qsm-book-to-skill doctor.description: Report the binary healthy and warn for each optional converter that is not on PATH, naming what installs it and which formats it reads
